approved_by: user, 2026-11-03: decided to make both knobs (INT16 prefill projections and the static-shift prefill softmax) fast mode's defaults and asked for documented validation; criteria reused unchanged from reference/router-english-gate-v1-budget.json, with the old fast defaults as the reference so that the two knobs are gated in isolation; fixed before any output of either arm on these pages existed
pages: reference/fast-defaults-gate-v1-masked-lock.json: the 156 pages of reference/fast-defaults-gate-v1-evaluation-lock.json (research/corpus-qualification/scripts/select_fast_defaults_gate.py: one page per document family, no family of corpus v1/v2/v3 or the English gate v1; formulas 42, tables 41, multi_column 30, other 43), figure regions without ground truth painted white on 66 of them (mask_excluded.py). The pool is the router development set (reference/router-dev-v1-*), which tuned only the image-size router and was never used for fast-mode numerics; this gate spends it. Prior exposure: router development ran an older fast mode on all 389 pool pages and reported its aggregate CER (research/resolution-router/README.md), and 17 of the 156 pages appeared in corpus v3's contact-sheet review (reference/corpus-v3-candidate-review.json); neither knob existed then, and no page was chosen or excluded by either arm's output
host: AMD Ryzen 7 7700X (8 cores, 16 threads; AVX2, AVX-512 with BF16 and VNNI), Linux

binary.source: branch feat/int8-rot at a837527, where both knobs exist and are off by default

reference.name: fast-old-defaults
reference.command: falcon-ocr --model artifacts/packed --mode fast run <156 canonical paths> --max-new-tokens 4096
reference.note: the old fast defaults, which are a837527's defaults: prefill projections panel-avx2, prefill attention bf16 with the online softmax

candidate.name: fast-new-defaults
candidate.command: falcon-ocr --model artifacts/packed --mode fast --tune prefill-i16=true --tune prefill-softmax=static run <156 canonical paths> --max-new-tokens 4096
candidate.note: the reference plus the two knobs that become fast mode's defaults; on this host the plan reads prefill projection panel-i16-vnni, attention bf16-static

procedure: one fresh process per arm over the masked lock's canonical paths in lock order, each under a shared hold on the host CPU lock; each arm's JSON lines converted by research/corpus-qualification/scripts/bench_report_from_run.py --lock reference/fast-defaults-gate-v1-masked-lock.json, which requires every lock page once, in order, with the lock's pixels
scope: pages where the reference (old fast defaults) ends at EOS
cer: raw-text Levenshtein distance to ground-truth.txt divided by ground-truth length, micro-averaged over characters, same treatment for both runs (research/phase4-hillclimb/attempt3/check_heldout.py --reference-report)
criteria_note: check_heldout.py names the reference `fp32`; here it is the old fast defaults, not FP32, so `repetition_stop_fires_on_fp32_eos_pages` counts the candidate's repetition stops on pages where the old fast defaults end at EOS
reported_not_gated: categories with fewer than 10 reference-EOS pages (none expected: every category has at least 30 pages)
time: not comparable, the host is shared with other work
